# lib/vendor/lib/
#
# This directory holds compiled native shared libraries generated by:
#
#   make build-simd-ffi
#
# Contents at build time:
#   libnode16_simd_ffi.so    (Linux)
#   libnode16_simd_ffi.dylib (macOS)
#   node16_simd_ffi.dll      (Windows)
#
# These files are listed in .gitignore and must be built locally before
# running any Go target with -tags simd_cgo.
